summary.title: Alder
summary.description: Genus of flowering plants in the birch family Betulaceae
summary.extract: Alders are trees of the genus Alnus in the birch family Betulaceae. The genus includes about 35 species of monoecious trees and shrubs, a few reaching a large size, distributed throughout the north temperate zone with a few species extending into Central America, as well as the northern and southern Andes.
